description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team: 

Upstart is looking for a Director of Internal Communications to evolve how employees understand the business we are building, how the company is performing and what our next chapter requires from them. Internal communications here is not a distribution function. It is a strategic capability that connects company decisions to our strategy, creates clarity during consequential moments and helps employees act with confidence.

 

You will join Upstart’s Communications, Culture & Development team, which helps employees understand where the company is going, feel connected to its purpose and build the capabilities to do their best work. You will evolve the strategy and operating rhythm for enterprise communications, serve as a senior partner to executives and functional leaders, and independently lead some of Upstart’s most consequential employee-facing work.

 

You will also own Upstart’s company knowledge strategy and core internal content portfolio, ensuring employees can find clear, current and trusted information across Guru and Glean. As our ways of working evolve, you will bring greater depth and thought leadership to our employee-facing GenAI communications and enablement strategy.

 

This is a role for a senior player-coach who sees beyond the immediate request, brings a strong point of view and stays close enough to the work to make the strategy real.

 

How you’ll make an impact

  • Evolve Upstart’s internal communications strategy and operating rhythm, including an enterprise employee calendar and governance practices that improve prioritization, timing and coordination.
  • Translate complex company priorities, performance and decisions into clear narratives that help employees understand where Upstart is headed, why it matters and what is expected of them.
  • Serve as a senior communications partner to the VP of Communications, Culture & Development and to executives and functional leaders on employee communications within the role’s portfolio.
  • Lead the strategy and end-to-end development of employee earnings communications, including the post-earnings all-hands, in partnership with Investor Relations, External Communications, Finance and senior leaders.
  • Build proactive communications strategies for priority company goals and enterprise changes, ensuring employees are brought along with clarity and appropriate context.
  • Own Upstart’s company knowledge strategy and core internal content portfolio. Establish the information architecture, editorial standards, governance and content lifecycle across Guru, Glean and emerging AI-enabled knowledge experiences.
  • Directly lead priority enterprise content while creating clear standards and accountability for specialized content owned by functions across Upstart.
  • Own the employee-facing GenAI communications and enablement strategy, helping employees understand how GenAI is changing the way we work and ensuring they are supported through that change.
  • Elevate flagship employee storytelling and connection through programs including Upstart Unlocked, Board and Lead-to-Lead conversations, ERG infrastructure, and employee recognition and anniversary experiences.
  • Partner closely with the Senior Manager of Internal Communications on TGIF, recurring employee communications, channel strategy, employer-brand storytelling and campaign execution.
  • Strengthen the function’s systems, measurement and decision rights so the team can operate with greater focus, consistency and impact.
  • Stay close to the work. Write, edit and deliver high-stakes communications; build the first version when something new is needed; and create repeatable approaches that allow the function to scale without sacrificing quality.
  •  

 

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 10+ years of experience in internal communications, executive communications, change communications or a related field, including experience operating at a senior strategic level in a complex organization.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, paired with the judgment to make complicated business topics clear without making them simplistic.
  • Experience counseling senior executives and the confidence to challenge, advise and improve a leader’s communication while preserving their voice and intent.
  • Strong business and financial fluency, including experience translating company performance, strategy and consequential organizational decisions for employees.
  • Demonstrated experience building communications strategies, planning rhythms and operating systems, not only executing individual campaigns or managing channels.
  • The ability to lead complex cross-functional work, influence without direct authority and make thoughtful tradeoffs across timing, message design and employee burden.
  • Experience leading, coaching or developing experienced communications talent.
  • The ability and willingness to move between strategy and execution, including personally writing and delivering high-priority work.
  • Strong judgment, intellectual curiosity and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the right path may not yet be defined.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with employee knowledge management, content governance, enterprise search or platforms such as Guru and Glean.
  • Experience developing communications or enablement strategies related to GenAI, digital transformation or significant changes in how employees work.
  • Experience in a public company, financial services, a regulated industry or another environment requiring close partnership with Investor Relations, Legal and Finance.
  • Experience supporting a distributed or digital-first workforce.

 

Position Location - This role is available in the following locations: Remote, Burlingame, CA, and Columbus, OH

Time Zone Requirements - This team operates on the East/West Coast time zones.

Travel Requirements - As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies, but in this role you can expect to travel 1-2 times per quarter.

 

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package.  The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range
$195,800—$271,000 USD

What you'll love

At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly 
  • Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)
  • Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.
  • Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)
  • Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security
  • Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements
  • Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)
  • Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources
  • Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)
  • Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you
  • Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from
  • Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)
  • Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City

For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.

Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices.

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate_accommodations@upstart.com
